note: Legend portraits, the dwarf (Lead via Strategy, Dom 2026-09-27). One FLUX.1 [dev] text-to-image per rung, from the source text in src/legends.ts; never from a film, comic or game depiction. Final size 512x512. `style` is appended to every subject. The prompt is `framing` + `subject` + `style`.
framing: Close-up head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large and filling the upper half of the square frame, cropped at the chest, of
style: Dark painterly realism like an old oil painting, ancient brutal ceremonial tone, grounded proportions, muted palette of bronze, iron, bone, leather, stone and ash, a single low warm torchlight from one side leaving the rest in deep shadow, dark smoky near-black background, no saturated colours, no glowing effects, no text, no border, no frame.

legends.name: Forge Hand
legends.subject: a soot-blackened young smith's apprentice, a scruffy beard, a scorched leather apron, a striker's hammer over his shoulder, a glowing forge behind him.

legends.name: Alvis
legends.subject: Alvis the all-wise Norse dwarf, a pale grey dwarf with a long white beard and a sharp clever face, dawn light creeping over his shoulder as his skin starts turning to stone.

legends.name: Regin
legends.subject: Regin the smith of the Volsunga saga, a crooked scheming old dwarf-smith with a forked beard, a leather apron, a newly forged sword blade on the anvil before him.

legends.name: Brokkr
legends.subject: Brokkr the Norse dwarf smith, a squat bearded dwarf working a leather bellows at a forge, a gadfly bite on his brow, a determined face.

legends.name: Eitri
legends.subject: Eitri the master dwarf smith, an old broad dwarf with a braided beard and a leather cap, holding a short-handled iron hammer, a gold ring and forge glow behind him.

legends.name: Wayland
legends.subject: Wayland the smith of Germanic legend, a lamed strong smith with a hard vengeful face, a beard, feathered wings of his own making on the wall behind him, a dark smithy.

legends.name: Kothar-wa-Khasis
legends.subject: Kothar-wa-Khasis the Canaanite craftsman god, a bearded man in a tall conical cap and fringed robe of the old Levant, holding a pair of forged clubs, a half-built palace behind him.

legends.name: Ptah
legends.subject: Ptah the Egyptian creator god of craftsmen, a man wrapped close in a mummiform robe with a close blue skullcap and a straight beard, holding a combined sceptre, a temple of Memphis behind him.

legends.name: Goibniu
legends.subject: The smith of the Tuatha De Danann who forged spearheads in three blows for the war on the Fomorians. In Frankendom he fights as the forge at full heat.

legends.name: Hephaestus
legends.subject: Hephaestus the lame smith god of Olympus, a strong bearded god in a short tunic and felt cap, sweat and soot, holding tongs over an anvil, bronze armour on the wall behind him.
